name: github-copilot-models-bridge
description: Bridges your logged-in GitHub Copilot models to local tools over HTTP. No PAT or separate model API key needed.

githubModelsBridge.port.description: Local port that the bridge listens on for /health and /chat requests.

githubModelsBridge.defaultModel.description: Default Copilot model family to use when /chat does not include a model (e.g. claude-haiku-4.5, gpt-4o, gemini-2.5-pro).
